headline: Quiet day: Microsoft drops a UK AI data center over grid delays
body: Another quiet day. Microsoft pulled out as anchor tenant of Nscale's 50 MW AI data center in Loughton, England, after grid connection delays pushed power into the 2030s, trimming Capability Velocity by 0.09. Enslaved God and Descendants each slipped 0.13-0.17 and Reversion edged up, with the rest of the drift coming from earlier news fading. Contained stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance was -8.17, from -8.22.
movers_note: Descendants -0.2, from fading earlier news (-0.11) and the Microsoft exit (-0.05). Conquerors -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.11) and the Microsoft exit (-0.04). Zookeeper -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.10) and the Microsoft exit (-0.04).
